newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin unit new labor pact approved.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin unit new labor pact approved.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp's tactical aircraft systems unit said Sunday that it had reached a new three-year labor pact with a division of the International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers.

The new contract, approved Sunday, gives union members two cash payments, two general wage increases, cost of living adjustments and current and retired employee benefit improvements over the three years, the company said.

It covers the 2,700-member production and maintenance unit, including production employees who build the F-16 and produce major components of the F-22 and Japan's F-2 fighter at the company's Fort Worth, Texas, plant.
The company said the contract goes into effect Monday.
